description: Master discovery configuration. 'defaults' is the global fallback layer for tunable parameters and IS read at runtime - precedence is: explicit command line > fast/deep parameterDefaults > these defaults > built-in fallback. Per-mode module enablement is driven by each module's own metadata (DefaultInFast / DefaultInDeep), refined by fast/deep discovery config plus command-line Include/Exclude. Every key below is consumed by code; do not add aspirational keys here - an unread key looks like a working knob and is worse than no key at all.
